name: Andrzej Halicki - § 27 - Am 43
title: REPORT on general guidelines for the preparation of the 2026 budget, Section III – Commission
part_text: 27. Observes that the need for the EU Member States to maintain a strong presence on the global stage is increasingly crucial amid escalating global conflicts, geopolitical shifts, foreign influence efforts worldwide, and the evolving dynamics of the EU’s relationships with other global political powers; stresses that this context must not be used as a pretext for the Union to increase its resources, worsening the budgetary imbalances of Member States or the tax burden on their citizens;
